Step 3

We'll update the Purchase List.

Current Edit button is probably something like:

JavaScript
onclick="editPurchase(${purchase.id})"

We'll change it to:

JavaScript
window.location.href =
`editPurchase.html?id=${purchase.id}`;

My suggestion

To save time and keep the UI perfectly consistent, we'll reuse almost all of the code from newPurchase.html, newPurchase.css, and newPurchase.js. We'll only change what's necessary for editing (loading existing data and updating instead of creating).

This avoids maintaining two completely different pages and gives users the same experience whether they're creating or editing a purchase.

We'll begin with Part 1: editPurchase.html, then move on to the JavaScript and backend update logic.
